probe.isolation: owned native C-Gate process; five loopback command sessions; no physical interface

config_inference.basis: Pinned build-2001 bytecode: oN stores any nonzero c digit in BG.c and registers the sink with BA; BA fans config text to every sink via BG.c(String), without inspecting BG.c. The s path does the same through BL and is independently observed above.
